meta.title: Quadra — find the day that works for everyone
meta.description: Create a plan, share the link and everyone paints the days they can make. Quadra marks the best one.

footer.tagline: Quadra · plans without endless group chats

landing.title: The day that works for everyone
landing.subtitle: Create a plan, share the link and everyone paints the days they can make. Quadra marks the best one.

guests.title: One link, that's it
guests.body: Whoever opens it types their name and marks their days. No sign-up, no app. Switching phones? They get a personal link.

grain.title: Days, slots or hours
grain.body: Pick whole days, named slots such as “Lunch” and “Dinner”, or an hourly grid in your time zone.

privacy.title: You decide what people see
privacy.body: Everyone sees who can make it, only the heatmap, or nothing from others. You always see the full table.

close.title: Close it, add it to calendars
close.body: Pick the final date: everyone gets a notice with the event for Google Calendar or Apple Calendar.

demo.sample: Example with four friends' answers. Paint over it: tap a day or drag.

auth.title: Sign in to Quadra
auth.subtitle: To create and manage plans. Answering never needs an account.
auth.error: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
auth.guestNote: No passwords: sign in with Google or with a link we email you.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
errors.server: We couldn't send the email. Please try again.

check.title: Check your email
check.body: We've sent you a sign-in link. Open it on this device; it expires in 24 hours.

dashboard.title: My plans
dashboard.emptyTitle: You haven't created a plan yet
dashboard.emptyBody: Create one, share the link and let everyone paint their days.
dashboard.participatingEmpty: Plans you answer while signed in will show up here.

errors.range_order: The end can't be before the start.
errors.range_too_long: The range can't be longer than 366 days.
errors.hours_order: The end time must be after the start time.

details.title: What's the plan?
details.name: Title
details.descriptionPlaceholder: Where, what to bring, anything people should know.

when.datesBody: Pick the days one by one.
when.openBody: Any day in the next year.
when.slotsHint: Between 1 and 6. They're just labels, no times.

answers.title: Possible answers
answers.description: What everyone can answer. The weight decides how much it counts towards the best day.
answers.lockedNote: There are answers already: you can rename and recolour, but not change weights or add or remove options.
answers.label: Answer {n}

privacy.title: Privacy and notices
privacy.fullBody: The heatmap and who answered what.
privacy.aggregateBody: How many can make it, no names.
privacy.hiddenBody: Everyone sees only their own answers.
privacy.notifyBody: When someone answers or changes their answers (at most one per person per hour).

created.title: Plan created
created.body: Share this link so people can mark when they can make “{title}”.
created.shareText: When can you make it? Mark your days for “{title}”.

participate.metaDescription: Mark the days you can make.
participate.inspectHint: Tap a cell to see who answered.
participate.paintHint: Pick an answer and tap the cells. Tap again to clear.
participate.tapToSee: Tap a cell to see who answered.
participate.personalLinkAgain: Your personal link to edit from another device
participate.personalLinkBody: Keep it to edit from another device. Anyone who has it can change your answers.
participate.hiddenNote: In this plan you only see your own answers.
participate.legendOthers: What {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} marked
participate.pickDay: Tap a day to see its slots.
participate.emptyWeek: This week has no hours in the plan.
participate.claimInvalid: That personal link is no longer valid.

join.title: Who are you?
join.name: Your name
join.emailHint: So we can tell you when the date is decided.

link.body: You already answered as {name} on this device. Link it to your account?

manage.editLocked: There are answers already, so some things can't change.

table.empty: No one has answered yet. Share the link.
table.deleteBody: All their answers will be deleted too. This can't be undone.

close.nothing: Once there are answers you can pick the final date.
